episodes.name: Vita da Iena - Il sottomarino - Acqua Golf
episodes.plot: Seduta sul suo scoglio, Marina la sirena gioca tranquillamente con una tartaruga marina. Sulla spiaggia dell'isola vicina, negli occhi affamati di Zig, il corpo della sirena si trasforma in un appetitoso trancio di pesce. Ma mentre la iena nuota verso la sirena, promessa di una succulenta cenetta, Zig sbatte in pieno contro la pinna di un enorme squalo…

episodes.name: Babysitting - Caccia a Sharko - Il cagnolino della sirena
episodes.plot: Marina deve fare la baby-sitter di un piccolo polipo. Sharko non sopporta il baby-sitting e scompare, vigliaccamente.

episodes.name: Surprise-party! - Moby Zig - Hic..fammi paura!
episodes.plot: Il compleanno di Marina è una buona occasione per Zig per organizzare una festicciola in suo onore e attirarla sull'isola. Sharko, che non ha dimenticato la data, si fa invitare. Disastro! Per evitare tutti i trabocchetti escogitati da Zig e Bernie, Sharko fa degli errori madornali, uno dopo l'altro…

episodes.name: In fondo al fondo - Zig e i Giocattoli - La Sirena Infermiera
episodes.plot: Zig e Sharko cadono in una faglia subacquea e arrivano nel mondo straordinario degli abissi e più precisamente in un villaggio, che esplorano con curiosità. Colti in flagrante delitto di vagabondaggio, sono incarcerati da un pesce poliziotto…

episodes.name: Il faro Bretone - Gambe in spalla - Medusa magica
episodes.plot: Mentre l'isola è immersa in una fitta nebbia, un faro immenso sorge nella laguna, impedendo a Zig di vedere la sua sirena. Armato di piccone, Zig decide di demolirlo. Ma il guardiano del faro, un vecchio bretone davvero coriaceo, non ha nessuna intenzione di lasciarglielo fare…

episodes.name: A secco - Guerra dei cloni - Un cugino di martello
episodes.plot: Bernie fabbrica dei cloni con le sembianze di Zig. I cloni si fanno prendere a botte al posto di Zig, ma sono sempre sconfitti. Ben presto un'orda di cloni incontrollabili invade la laguna che si trasforma in un allegro bazar. Marina troverà la soluzione per riportare la calma sulla laguna, ma fino a quando?

episodes.name: Marina si fa i capelli - Gonfio come un pallone - Il giro dell'isola
episodes.plot: Marina si fa bella per andare all'opera. Ma il polipo parrucchiere fa una mossa sbagliata e le taglia metà capigliatura… Disastro! Le occorre una parrucca. Sharko si precipita a tosare tutte le bestie dell'isola (tranne Zig) e ritorna con ogni tipo di parrucca, ma nessuna piace a Marina. Solo i peli della criniera di Zig le fanno voglia…

episodes.name: Il furore della Iena - La corte di Re Nettuno - Il ritorno del delfino suonato
episodes.plot: Mentre sta facendo jogging, re Nettuno vede la sirena e se ne innamora follemente. Marina è alquanto lusingata… Ma Sharko non ha nessuna intenzione di permettere a quel grassone con la barba di rubargli il suo pranzetto.

episodes.name: Zig Taxi - Sharko e i suoi - Un carattere vulcanico
episodes.plot: Zig costruisce un taxi pattino, il che capita a fagiolo per Marina, che sogna di fare shopping in taxi! Zig imbarca la bella, mentre Sharko si lancia al loro inseguimento su un altro taxi, guidato da Bernie, di cui prende il timone. Segue una serie di soste in varie boutique e di altrettanti scambi di veicoli.

episodes.name: Il tunnel sotto la laguna - La banda di Barbak - Il Mini Re
episodes.plot: Zig decide di scavare un tunnel dall'isola allo scoglio della sirena. Dopo un primo tentativo fallito, gli viene un'idea: usare Bernie e le sue chele come scavatrice. Lo scavatore improvvisato è efficientissimo ma il sottosuolo di un'isola deserta può riservare tante belle sorprese…

episodes.name: Tutti in giostra! - Liberate Marina - Un naufrago romantico
episodes.plot: A Zig viene un'idea: costruire un luna park per intrappolare Marina. La sirena si dà alla pazza gioia. Sharko cerca di farle evitare il peggio.

episodes.name: Tutti in acqua- Via Reale - Origami
episodes.plot: All'improvviso le acque della laguna salgono e ricoprono quasi completamente l'isola. Sharko e Marina ne approfittano per visitare l'isola sottacqua, ma Marina si perde. Come Pollicino, semina noci di cocco sul suo cammino perché Sharko la ritrovi, ma Bernie sta all'erta…

episodes.name: Cowboy - In Crociera - Famiglia numerosa, famiglia felice
episodes.plot: Zig e Sharko s'inseguono in groppa a due ippocampi. Dopo una rissa, Zig è completamente stordito. Quando torna in sé e va da Marina, tutto è cambiato: Zig si ritrova in un western! Marina canta nel saloon, Bernie al piano, e ovviamente duello al vertice fra Sharko e Zig.

episodes.name: Bernie trasloca- L'amica di Marina - Marea nera
episodes.plot: Un'eruzione vulcanica sottomarina fa apparire una seconda isola. Bernie, che ha litigato con Zig, va ad abitarci. Mentre Zig sgobba tutto solo, Bernie si costruisce una villa da sogno sulla sua isola e si diverte con Sharko e Marina. Ma una nuova eruzione fa affondare la seconda isola…

episodes.name: Ritorno al paese - Il piccolo gambero - La mia amica gamberetto
episodes.plot: Zig scopre un libro sulla fauna africana e capisce che quelle sono le sue origini. Decide quindi di andare in Africa e di conoscere i suoi compatrioti: elefanti, giraffe, ecc. Ma le iene non sono tanto amate laggiù e nessuno lo tratta bene. Sharko è depresso per la mancanza di Zig. Marina decide di andare a cercare la iena.

episodes.name: Disastro in campeggio - Il fan - Retata
episodes.plot: Sharko porta Marina in vacanza in… campeggio! Delusione totale per Marina, che si aspettava un hotel 5 stelle. I vicini di tenda sono… Zig e Bernie! Le vacanze non saranno di tutto riposo per Sharko…

episodes.name: Marina Superstar - I muratori della Laguna - Il fantasma ingombrante
episodes.plot: Nettuno sente cantare Marina e vuole registrare un disco. Il disco piace talmente che Marina parte in tournée. Zig e Sharko hanno nostalgia della loro sirena, ovviamente per ragioni diverse. Si alleano di nuovo per fare ritornare la loro star.

episodes.name: Sci nautico - Un bel colpo di bambù - Allarme: sirena!
episodes.plot: Sfogliando una rivista di gossip, Marina vede la foto di bei giovani abbronzati che fanno sci nautico. Vuole anche lei giocare con quel coso buffo. Poco dopo infatti, la sirena si diverte da matti a fare slalom sulle onde trainata da Sharko che funge da fuoribordo. Zig decide allora di darsi anche lui allo sci nautico per catturare Marina…

episodes.name: Un desiderio esaudito - Facciatosta - Un amico di un certo peso
episodes.plot: Marina sogna talmente di avere delle gambe che una notte il suo desiderio è esaudito da una fatina che passa di là. Ma la vita con due gambe non è per niente facile ! Marina non sa camminare bene, non sa più nuotare e il suo amico Sharko è molto triste. La sirena vorrebbe che tutto ritornasse come prima…

episodes.name: Colpo di freddo - Figlia dell'aria - Duello fra casanova
episodes.plot: Una bufera di neve si abbatte sull'isola e ben presto tutto è imprigionato nel ghiaccio. Sulla laguna si è formata una vera e propria banchisa che isola lo scoglio di Marina. Anche Sharko è bloccato sotto il ghiaccio, così Zig ha via libera per andare a prendere la sirena! Ma non è l'unico in lizza e il suo nuovo rivale non è meno impressionante del vecchio…

episodes.name: Ispettore Sharko - Vita da diporto - Gioco di prestigio
episodes.plot: Marina trova che sulla laguna regnino troppe ingiustizie e decreta che Sharko è il nuovo rappresentante locale delle forze dell'ordine. Lo squalo prende molto sul serio il suo ruolo e distribuisce multe a colpi di pinna. Zig cerca di sfruttare le nuove funzioni del nemico distrarre la sua attenzione, ma Sharko è troppo zelante…

episodes.name: Strane macchine- Liberate Marina - Attenzione al succo!
episodes.plot: Nella stiva del cargo di nuovo arenato sulla spiaggia, molto deluso, Zig trova solo un vecchio libro. Ma si tratta del famoso Codice Atlantico di Leonardo da Vinci, con gli schizzi di tutte le sue invenzioni. Di sicuro troverà un'idea per costruire una macchina per catturare la sirena! Bisogna comunque essere un genio…

episodes.plot: Una nave che serve da base di lancio per un missile è ormeggiata nella laguna. episodes.name: Il Dio del vulcano - Spa - Magico!
episodes.plot: Marina ha un nuovo pretendente, il che non piace né a Zig, né a Sharko. A Marina nemmeno perché, anche si tratta di un dio antico, non è per niente affascinante…

translations.value: Il Dio del vulcano - Spa - Magico!

episodes.name: Caccia alla caramella - Il profumo della iena - La Guardia del corpo
episodes.plot: Marina è golosissima di caramelle! Finalmente Zig ha trovato un'esca par attirare la sirena! Per Sharko sarà una bella impresa dover proteggere la sua bella inculcandole l'abc del « mangia e cammina ».

episodes.name: Le sirene contrattaccano - Una sirena caritatevole - La buona stella
episodes.plot: Tre sirene sbarcano sull'isola per seguire un corso di autodifesa con Sharko. Zig ha l'acquolina in bocca all'idea di farsi un bel banchetto! Marina è tutta contenta di aver trovato delle amiche. Ma non sarà una giornata di tutto riposo…

episodes.name: Pirati della strada in spiaggia - Arrivano le cugine - Fratelli al latte
episodes.plot: Sharko ha un progetto romanticissimo: lui e Marina, una macchina lussuosa e comoda che li porti a fare un picnic a tu per tu davanti a un panorama degno delle più belle copertine di romanzetti rosa! Solo che Zig e Bernie s'immischiano…

episodes.name: Il re degli animali - I turisti - Primo della classe
episodes.plot: Delle lucertole gigantesche sbarcano sulla spiaggia per proteggere Zig da ogni aggressione. Per loro la iena è all'apice della piramide gerarchica degli animali e merita rispetto! Zig è contentissimo ma i suoi protettori hanno un'altra idea in testa…

episodes.plot: Marina è nel suo castello. Tutto è lusso, calma e voluttà quando all'improvviso

Marina è nel suo castello. Tutto è lusso, calma e voluttà quando all'improvviso

episodes.name: Miniature - L'alieno - Papà chioccia
episodes.plot: « Zzz zzz »: arriva una mosca a rovinarle quel momento di beatitudine. Sharko fa fatica ad aiutarla. Zig e Bernie arrivano in versione ""cacciatori di animali dannosi""…

episodes.name: Perduti nella giungla - Il cagnolino di papà - Marina e i bachi da seta
episodes.plot: Zig trova nella carlinga una pistola con un design futurista e colorato. Preme il grilletto e hop! Rimpicciolisce Bernie! Geniale! Ecco una bella trovata per ridurre Sharko in pesciolino fritto e catturare la sirena…

episodes.name: Capelli a gò gò- Lassù sulla montagna - La mummia
episodes.plot: Come al solito impegnatissimi nei loro inseguimenti, Zig e Sharko finiscono per perdersi nella giungla. E di fronte all'universo pericoloso e inquietante della natura selvaggia i due nemici devono mettere da parte i loro antagonismi e allearsi.

episodes.name: Ci vediamo un film? - Sabbie mobili - Ribelli
episodes.plot: Marina ha i capelli con le doppie punte e si fa una maschera capillare miracolosa. Il giorno dopo ha una capigliatura incredibilmente lunga: impossibile pettinarsi senza l'aiuto di un professionista. Zig ha trovato un lavoro!

episodes.name: Il giocattolo che fa muuuh - I re del furto - Boiiing Boiiing
episodes.plot: Sharko propone a Marina una cosetta romantica e tranquilla: una serata dvd. Ma Zig e Bernie hanno affisso un cartello sul cancello del castello con scritto ""Cinema""! La serata per i due innamorati non sarà per niente tranquilla…

episodes.name: Il panda malefico- Sul filo - Uno, due, tre e stella!
episodes.plot: Bernie inventa una cosa incredibile: il giocattolo che muggisce. Niente d'interessante a priori, eppure Marina lo trova eccezionale. Allora la scatola che muggisce diventa un'esca straordinaria… Ma anche Sharko farebbe di tutto per impadronirsi di uno di quei giocattolini…

episodes.name: Amici del cuore - LOL Zig - La regina delle gaffe
episodes.plot: Vulcano ha deciso di riprovare a sedurre la sirena. Ma, niente da fare, non è davvero il suo tipo… Per accostarla si trasforma in Panda gigante carinissimo. Zig e Sharko sospettano qualcosa, ma troppo tardi…

episodes.name: Il trenino - La caduta - Miss Spiaggia
episodes.plot: L'epoca dell'infanzia e dei vecchi amici. Zig, Sharko e Bernie fanno comunella quando una sirenetta, bella da… essere sgranocchiata, irrompe nel loro mondo e manda all'aria gli equilibri esistenti. Marina è entrata nella loro vita!

translations.value: Il trenino - La caduta - Miss Spiaggia

episodes.name: Zig Chef - Il giorno più lungo - Cavallo vincente
episodes.plot: Marina è appassionata di trenini elettrici. Zig e Bernie capitano all'improvviso con un vero treno in miniatura che funziona benissimo. Marina salta immediatamente sul treno e Sharko impedisce a Zig e a Bernie di partecipare al viaggio. Come faranno per riacciuffare la sirena?

episodes.name: Le leggi d'attrazione - Pezzi scelti - Chewing-gum
episodes.plot: Sharko è un pessimo cuoco. Decide allora di andare a lezione dal migliore cuoco dell'isola: Zig! Eccoli quindi riuniti con forni, pentole ed erbe rare. E nel bel mezzo Marina sogna, entusiasta all'idea di assaggiare. Zig invece sogna di assaporare lei...

episodes.name: Il ballo del vampiro - La maledizione - Colpo di calore
episodes.plot: Un aereo perde una cassa di calamite che si schianta ai piedi di Zig e Bernie. Le calamite volano via e inchiodano i due compari alle pareti dell'aereo! Bernie ha un'idea: fabbricare una bella collana magnetica per attirare Marina…

episodes.name: Vegeziz - Gioco, set, partita - Il dentifricio
episodes.plot: Sharko e Marina stanno guardando un film di vampiri e sono impauriti. Zig e Bernie decidono di appropriarsi del telecomando per terrorizzare Sharko e sequestrare tranquillamente la sirena. Ma vampiri non ci si improvvisa …

episodes.name: Brico-Sharko - La proposta - Un'altra dimensione
episodes.plot: Sconvolto dai tentativi pietosi e sempre più ridicoli di Zig per catturare la sirena, Bernie vuole porvi fine. Con Sharko decide di ipnotizzare Zig con un pendolino per farlo diventare vegetariano…

Stagione 3

episodes.name: Welcome on board
episodes.plot: Marina dreams of sailing the sea, so Zig asks Bernie to build a cruise ship where all her friends can hop aboard! However, all awhile, Sharko believes this cruise vacation is another one of Zig's traps. When the boat is taking a dangerous course, Zig and Sharko are too busy bickering as always to save the day… who will come to the rescue?

translations.value: Welcome on board

episodes.name: Daddy cool
episodes.plot: Zig dresses up as a cute baby so that Marina takes care of him. But the mermaid is too busy and asks Sharko to babysit Zig! The shark develops strong paternal feelings towards the kid and is heartbroken when he finds out his true identity.

translations.value: Daddy cool

episodes.name: Nurse Marina
episodes.plot: Marina replaces the ship's nurse for the day, so Zig pretends to be hurt to be alone with her in the infirmary, but Sharko is not fooled and does the same thing.

translations.value: Nurse Marina

episodes.name: Safety first
episodes.plot: When the emergency alarm rings by mistake, everyone panics! Sharko decides to organize safety training to protect everyone in case of an emergency. But Marina isn’t a very serious student, and Zig sabotages the classes to seize the mermaid.

translations.value: Safety first

episodes.name: The storm
episodes.plot: When a huge thunderstorm forces everyone to go inside the ship, Zig takes advantage of Sharko's seasickness to catch Marina whenever she has to save passengers that got stuck outside.

translations.value: The storm

episodes.name: The Treasure hunt
episodes.plot: Zig sends Marina and Sharko on a fake treasure hunt in order to catch the mermaid, but they end up discovering a real abandoned galleon with cursed treasure inside.

translations.value: The Treasure hunt

episodes.name: Sharko my hero
episodes.plot: The baby swordfish starts idolizing Sharko to the point of repeating his every move, much to the shark's embarrassment.

translations.value: Sharko my hero

episodes.name: Under the sea
episodes.plot: When the ship sinks underwater, Sharko tries to take the opportunity to kill some nostalgic memories of swimming in the ocean, but Marina forces him to help her fix the boat instead.

translations.value: Under the sea

episodes.name: Do not disturb
episodes.plot: Zig tries to eat Marina at night while she's sleeping, so Sharko must save her without making too much noise, as she gets extremely angry when woken up.

translations.value: Do not disturb

episodes.name: Blindman's buff
episodes.plot: Sharko must stop Marina from being lured into Zig's stomach during a game of blind man's buff.

translations.value: Blindman's buff

episodes.name: Zig the gardener
episodes.plot: After accidentally tossing Sharko's fertilizer in the ocean, Marina creates a new one that makes all the plants in his garden grow huge. However, when Bernie's small carnivorous plant drinks an entire bottle of the substance, it turns into a giant monster.

translations.value: Zig the gardener

episodes.name: Garbage galore
episodes.plot: The ocean liner makes a stop off a magnificent desert island. When Sharko turns the beautiful beach into a garbage dump, Marina orders him to clean it up. Of course, Zig and Bernie turn his task into a nightmare to keep the shark busy.

translations.value: Garbage galore

episodes.name: Freezing buddies
episodes.plot: After a high-speed chase across the ship, Zig and Sharko get stuck inside the kitchen’s cold room. The shark and the hyena will soon have to forget their differences and combine forces to find a way out of this tricky situation...

translations.value: Freezing buddies

episodes.name: Frosty friendship
episodes.plot: After the ship crashes into an iceberg, Marina decides to explore it and befriends a penguin living there. However, once the ship is repaired, the creepy little bird refuses to let her or Sharko leave.

translations.value: Frosty friendship

episodes.name: The maze
episodes.plot: Zig, Bernie, Sharko and Marina land in a labyrinth of corridors and pipes in the engine room. While Sharko tries to find the exit, Zig tries to grab Marina every time he is not looking.

translations.value: The maze

episodes.name: The parsley
episodes.plot: Marina gets a piece of parsley stuck in-between her teeth, but she does not notice it, even after Sharko tries to explain it to her. This causes the shark and the other cruisers to run away from her in disgust, except for Zig, who takes advantage of the situation in order to eat her.

translations.value: The parsley

episodes.name: Viking love
episodes.plot: Olga-the-terrible, a Viking chieftain has fallen head over heels in love with Zig. He is quite happy to have her shield him against Sharko, but not so happy with the fact that she keeps him away from Marina who Olga sees as a rival…

translations.value: Viking love

episodes.name: Hide and squeek
episodes.plot: Marina and Sharko are playing hide and seek, but the mermaid is not very good at hiding. However, she eventually finds a spot so good that neither the shark or Zig can find her, no matter how hard they look.

translations.value: Hide and squeek

episodes.name: The invaders
episodes.plot: Rats invade the boat! Marina tries to get rid of them and Sharko would like to help, but he is terrified by the rodents… Zig and Bernie will use his weakness to their advantage. Will Sharko be able to overcome his phobia to save Marina?

translations.value: The invaders

episodes.name: The pranksters
episodes.plot: Sharko can’t stand gags and pranks, so Marina teams up with Zig and Bernie to loosen him up. But they take advantage and double-up their gags to overpower the shark. Is Sharko the only one who doesn’t have a sense of humor?

translations.value: The pranksters

episodes.name: Synchronized swimming
episodes.plot: Sharko has a secret passion for synchronized swimming! Marina decides to make him the star of the swimming pool. Zig finds him absolutely ridiculous… and is very pleased to discover that mockery can be a powerful weapon against the shark!

translations.value: Synchronized swimming

episodes.name: Spotless
episodes.plot: Sharko's romantic dinner with Marina keeps getting interrupted by Bernie and Zig's constant attempts to smudge his fancy suit.

translations.value: Spotless

episodes.name: Old buddies
episodes.plot: Sharko is happy to be reunited with two old friends from his teenage years, but Marina isn't very fond of their rebellious ways.

translations.value: Old buddies

episodes.name: A hell of a friend
episodes.plot: Hades visits the ship in order to finally get a kiss from Marina, but she could be more horrified of him.

translations.value: A hell of a friend

episodes.name: Robot craze
episodes.plot: Marina has a new obsession: giant robots! This gives Zig an idea, maybe he could defeat Sharko with the right armor. But Sharko has no trouble beating up Zig-Robot… until the hyena shows up in a real giant robot.

translations.value: Robot craze

episodes.name: Bionic Butler
episodes.plot: Marina and Sharko wanted to buy a dinner robot and Zig had an idea to eat to make Bernie a robot and his income but the real dinner robot came and his Zig vacation unintentionally began to crash.

translations.value: Bionic Butler

episodes.name: Grounded !
episodes.plot: Sharko and the animals are thirsty and around the world the water does not exist and marina checks for one of its free, Zig and Bernie to give water in the mold to eat marina.

translations.value: Grounded !

episodes.name: The Kiss
episodes.plot: Marina reads a fairytale about a frog changing into Prince Charming after being kissed and totally believes in it. Zig takes advantage of her gullibility to attract her into various traps, but he mainly attracts Sharko’s jealousy and rage.

translations.value: The Kiss

episodes.name: A beautiful shell
episodes.plot: This morning Bernie's day, but he is too small to care for him returned Zig Bernie back to the hopper to the ground and broke his helmet and saw the colored animal was Zig and Marina and Sharko much loved him and gave him the idea Bernie to love.

translations.value: A beautiful shell

episodes.name: The song of the sirens
episodes.plot: When the ocean liner passes off Siren Island, Sharko is drawn to the evil sirens. Fortunately, Marina is there to save him...

translations.value: The song of the sirens

episodes.name: Hats off to the artist
episodes.plot: Bernie organizes a painting workshop to allow Zig to approach Marina. Sharko joins them to keep an eye on the hyena. Marina is happy to be with her friends but is quickly frustrated to discover that they draw better than her...

translations.value: Hats off to the artist

episodes.name: A star on board !
episodes.plot: A famous actor of which Sharko and Marina are fans comes to stay on the boat. When Zig discovers that the star is wearing a mask that makes him beautiful and strong, he intends to use it to attract and eat the mermaid...

translations.value: A star on board !

episodes.name: Operation Santa Claus
episodes.plot: It’s Christmas! Zig dresses up as Santa Claus, but Sharko is no fool. However, he himself has to dress the part to replace the hyena after ejecting him into orbit. He’d rather keep an eye on Marina than play Santa!

translations.value: Operation Santa Claus

episodes.name: The mermaid’s feast
episodes.plot: Sharko wants to offer Marina a romantic dinner in the boat’s restaurant but has to keep a close eye on Zig to prevent the mermaid from becoming the main course. Meanwhile, Marina is hungry, in fact so hungry she could eat a hyena…

translations.value: The mermaid’s feast

episodes.name: Atchoo!
episodes.plot: When Marina starts taking care of a baby seagull, Sharko discovers that he's allergic to feathers! Of course, Zig makes the most of the shark's weakness. He feathers the little gull to keep Sharko away from the mermaid to savor her!

translations.value: Atchoo!

episodes.name: Virtual Attraction
episodes.plot: Marina is addicted to a VR game and she completely ignores Sharko. Zig is going to try and take advantage of the situation. And when the shark tries to rescue his mermaid, it’s he who gets trapped in the VR headset …

translations.value: Virtual Attraction

episodes.name: Rockstar Marina
episodes.plot: Marina decides to set up a rock group and enlists her friends. During rehearsals Sharko turns out to be a very bad musician and gets kicked out of the group. But with the involuntary help of Zig, he will reveal his true talent during the concert!

translations.value: Rockstar Marina

episodes.name: The fitness session
episodes.plot: Marina is eager to exercise and signs up for fitness training. Of course, Zig conspires to take on the role of a fitness coach to move in on Marina… and to beat Sharko on his own turf: the gym!

translations.value: The fitness session

episodes.name: Sharko’s best friend
episodes.plot: An alien called Blobi turns up an onboard ship to enjoy himself. Sharko thinks he’s really cute and becomes great pals with him. But Blob is hungry, and when he’s hungry, he’ll eat anything, including mermaids… For once Zig is here to protect Marina!

translations.value: Sharko’s best friend

episodes.name: Zig's shadow
episodes.plot: When Bernie takes a photo of Zig with a strange camera, the shadow of the hyena comes to life. Completely independent of Zig, this creature will prove to be a precious ally for him and a real problem for Sharko...

translations.value: Zig's shadow

episodes.name: The nap
episodes.plot: Marina, Zig and Sharko go back to childhood remembering a famous afternoon nap by the water. Baby Marina is not sleepy and wants to fetch a mysterious object in the water while Baby Zig wants to make the mermaid her snack...

translations.value: The nap

episodes.name: Sink or swim
episodes.plot: Marina signs up for a swimming race and takes Sharko as coach. Zig participates too but he is so bad that Bernie has to give him a serious boost. Objective: to win the race but above all to bite the siren...

translations.value: Sink or swim

episodes.name: A ball on the loose
episodes.plot: Marina and Sharko try to catch and return a ball to two kids after it starts bouncing all over the ship, but Zig's attempts to eat Marina get in the way.

translations.value: A ball on the loose

episodes.name: A castle built for two
episodes.plot: Night has fallen over the ship. Bernie and the Starfish are finally alone together. They hope to spend a romantic night in their little castle, but it turns out to be more complicated than planned when Marina, Zig and Sharko decide to join them.

translations.value: A castle built for two

episodes.name: The serenade
episodes.plot: As Marina prepares to fall asleep, Sharko comes to serenade under her windows, hoping for a kiss. But Zig and Bernie take the opportunity to sabotage his performances in order to climb to the balcony in his place and be able to eat the mermaid...

translations.value: The serenade

episodes.name: Best girlfriends
episodes.plot: Zig disguises herself as a little girl and leads Marina into activities "forbidden to boys" to keep her away from Sharko. The shark would not only like to play with them, but also protect Marina. What if he too became his best friend?

translations.value: Best girlfriends

episodes.name: My buddy Bigfoot
episodes.plot: The ship stops on the Arctic Circle, where Zig meets a Bigfoot! The snow creature thinks Zig is just too cute and adopts him as a pet toy. Zig tries to train his new buddy to demolish Sharko, but Bigfoot’s not super smart…

translations.value: My buddy Bigfoot

episodes.name: A brother's tiff
episodes.plot: Zig and Bernie get confused. Bernie, annoyed, refuses to speak to the hyena. Zig wants to prove that he can manage on his own. Affected by the situation, Sharko and Marina will put in place a plan to reconcile the brothers...

translations.value: A brother's tiff

episodes.name: The diving contest
episodes.plot: Zig and Sharko have signed up for a driving contest. The winner gets to dine privately with Captain Marina! But when Sharko reaches the diving board, he realizes that he’s scared to death of heights.

translations.value: The diving contest

episodes.name: The elevator trip
episodes.plot: Zig and Marina get stuck inside the elevator together, so the former tries to take the opportunity to eat the latter, but his claustrophobia gets the better of him. Meanwhile, Sharko and Bernie team up to save the mermaid and the hyena.

translations.value: The elevator trip

episodes.name: Childhood treasure
episodes.plot: Marina refuses to hang out with Sharko after he accidentally breaks her favorite music box, so he must get her a new one before Zig eats her first.

translations.value: Childhood treasure

episodes.name: Foggy day
episodes.plot: Bernie creates a device that buries the ship in a thick mist, so Zig can catch Marina without Sharko seeing him.

translations.value: Foggy day

episodes.name: The rival
episodes.plot: A big, new handsome shark comes aboard! Competition, based on mutual jealousy, soon develops between Sharko and Sharky. But when Marina is in danger, the sharks rise above their rivalry to join forces against Zig, to save her.

translations.value: The rival

episodes.name: Sharko on Ice
episodes.plot: During a stopover on the ice, Sharko thinks of sharing a romantic moment with Marina by inviting her to dance as a duo on the ice. But the shark turns out to be a poor skater and Zig an ace on the ice...

translations.value: Sharko on Ice

episodes.name: The mime
episodes.plot: A mime follows Sharko, publicizing his upcoming show onboard the ship. Sharko gets very annoyed, and ends up knocking the guy out by accident… This means he has to replace the mime in the show, along with Zig…

translations.value: The mime

episodes.name: Mobilemania
episodes.plot: Sharko is addicted to Marina's cell phone. Zig and Bernie order one, just to work Marina quietly. Conquered by his "precious" laptop, the shark will have to make a choice: his laptop or the beautiful mermaid...

translations.value: Mobilemania

episodes.name: Banana peel
episodes.plot: Zig and Bernie find a crate filled with bananas in the hold of the boat. This is the perfect accessory for setting ever more slippery traps in Sharko. It is best to be vigilant before putting any toes on the bridge...

translations.value: Banana peel

episodes.name: Saturday night dance
episodes.plot: Sharko is looking forward to the cruise ship’s bell, so he can finally dance the tango with Marina… but Zig takes advantage of the party and use crazy dances to approach the mermaid discreetly.

translations.value: Saturday night dance

episodes.name: The clairvoyant
episodes.plot: When the strange tortoises tell Sharko and Marina a bad story, Sharko is afraid that it will happen.

translations.value: The clairvoyant

episodes.name: Lost at sea
episodes.plot: During a fight, Zig and Sharko tumble into a lifeboat. The lifeboat breaks off from the ship and falls into the water. Before they know it, they’re adrift in the ocean! Can they overcome past differences to survive… and get back on the cruise boat?

translations.value: Lost at sea

episodes.name: The power of the cape
episodes.plot: Zig is stealing a mysterious cape from Hades, which has magical power. A new trick to go after Marina the mermaid as she was spending a lovely evening with Sharko looking at the stars.

translations.value: The power of the cape

episodes.name: The rare bird
episodes.plot: Marina and a little reassured Sharko disembark on the island for a night excursion in search of a mysterious bird: the Kakaput. But Zig and Bernie intend to exploit the Sharko's and take the opportunity to work the siren...

translations.value: The rare bird

episodes.name: Deafening noise
episodes.plot: Sharko's hearing becomes highly sensitive after an accident involving the ship's horn, which proves to be a useful weakness to Zig.

translations.value: Deafening noise

episodes.name: Daddy Bernie
episodes.plot: Bernie invents a device to change Sharko into a baby, so Zig can devour the defenseless mermaid. But his experiment goes wrong and Bernie ends up having to deal with three babies: Sharko, Marina, and Zig! Will he be able to cope with this situation?

translations.value: Daddy Bernie

episodes.name: A pearl for my girl
episodes.plot: Sharko decides to offer a giant and sparkling pearl to Marina, hoping to win her heart. But Zig and Bernie work out the most cunning plans possible to steal the pearl and prevent Sharko from giving her his precious gift.

translations.value: A pearl for my girl

episodes.name: The boating licence
episodes.plot: After yet another liner accident, Marina decides to undergo accelerated-training for pilot Aldo.  Sharko ensures the safety of the course because Zig takes every opportunity to try to delight the siren.

translations.value: The boating licence

episodes.name: North Pole Movie
episodes.plot: While on a port-of-call in the Antarctic, Marina wants to make a documentary about penguins. Sharko is her production assistant but can’t stand the cold. Zig plays this to his advantage to try and catch the mermaid.

translations.value: North Pole Movie

episodes.name: A pie dream
episodes.plot: After accidentally taking a cream pie in the face, Sharko is at a low point. He dozes off and has dreams as far-fetched as each other ... Dreams that will help him free himself from the trauma of his childhood.

translations.value: A pie dream

episodes.name: Wide awake
episodes.plot: Sharko, after a good day, is about to fall into a restful sleep. But Zig and Bernie take pleasure in spoiling his night. In the early hours, Sharko did not close his eyes and was exhausted. Difficult to watch over Marina in this state!

translations.value: Wide awake

episodes.name: A heroic tale
episodes.plot: Sharko, Zig and Bernie remember the time their boat almost sank when it hit a rock. Obviously Sharko says he saved the liner... But now, no one has the same version of the story and all declare  themselves as the hero of that day.

translations.value: A heroic tale

episodes.name: Replicas
episodes.plot: Bernie invented a machine capable of creating plastic clones from real characters. Everyone will be entitled to his double. Could this be the winning strategy to trick Sharko and crunch the mermaid?

translations.value: Replicas

episodes.name: Mechanical jaws
episodes.plot: Zig and Bernie tinker with a box that allows them to control Sharko's jaw. The shark then involuntarily attacks Marina. Sharko does not understand what is happening to him, and fights against his dentures to save the mermaid!

translations.value: Mechanical jaws

episodes.name: The crosswalk
episodes.plot: Sharko tries to help an elderly turtle cross a road, but Zig and Bernie don't make it easy for him.

translations.value: The crosswalk

episodes.name: The cloud
episodes.plot: An evil lightning bolt strikes the ship’s clock and puts it out of joint. Time accelerates. All the ship’s passengers suddenly grow old. When Bernie tries to repair the clock, he inverses the process: everyone on board turns into a baby…

translations.value: The cloud

episodes.name: The captain's evening
episodes.plot: Marina prefers stargazing to the Captain's Gala evening.

translations.value: The captain's evening

episodes.name: Game over
episodes.plot: Sharko is determined to defeat the final boss on an old arcade game, but Zig's constant attempts to eat Marina prevent him from doing so.

translations.value: Game over

episodes.name: Titazig
episodes.plot: Sharko wants to recreate a romantic scene with Marina from the movie “Titanic” on the ship’s top deck, whereas Zig and Bernie aim to recreate the shipwreck scene, take advantage of the chaos and nab the mermaid…

translations.value: Titazig

episodes.name: Poseidon's visit
episodes.plot: Poseidon wants Marina to marry a merman, so Zig disguises himself as one to get close to her.

translations.value: Poseidon's visit
